about: Numbers whose community reports are set aside, because a script sent them and not people who got the call. merge_community_reports.py and generate_hot_list.py skip every report for a number listed here, so reports can't publish it, put it on the watch list or make it trend, and a row that only reports published comes back out at the next merge. A row another source backs stays as it is. Every entry needs the number, a held_at date and a note on what was seen. One entry per number. To lift a hold, delete its entry.
